modules.attendance: Take the register from a phone, lateness, absences and statistics.
modules.assessments: Homework, tests and exams, grade entry and approval.
modules.results: Averages, coefficients, rankings and PDF report cards.

finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Fees, invoices, discounts and what each student owes.
finance.invoicesIntro: Invoices are issued automatically when a student is enrolled, from the fees set up for their level.
finance.generateHint: Issues this year's fees to every enrolled student who does not have an enrolment invoice yet — for example after setting up the fees.
finance.withoutFees_one: {{count}} student is in a level with no fees set up for this year.

finance.searchInvoices: Search by number, student name or ID…

finance.discountTooLarge: The discount cannot be larger than the amount.
finance.cancelInvoiceHint: The invoice stays on record, marked as cancelled. Issue a new one if the amounts were wrong.
finance.categoriesHint: The kinds of fees the school charges. Click one to edit it.
finance.noCategories: No fee categories yet. Start with registration and tuition.
finance.schedulesHint: What each level pays this year, and when each installment is due.
finance.noFees: No fees for this level yet.
finance.feeHint: Invoices already issued keep their amounts; changes apply to new invoices.
finance.installmentsMismatch: The installments must add up to the fee amount.
finance.confirmDeleteFee: Delete the fee “{{name}}” for this level? Invoices already issued are not changed.

finance.fixedNeedsCategory: Choose the fee a fixed amount applies to.
